target: with no configuration a documented default threshold applies
cmd: cat "$FIXTURES/preflight/brief-large.json" | env -u MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE -u OPENAI_API_KEY -u OPENROUTER_API_KEY -u FABLE_KEY bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary 2>err >/dev/null; T=$(grep -o "threshold [0-9.]* USD" err | grep -o "[0-9.]*"); echo "DEFAULT=$T"
_note: Asserts the default VALUE, not just that the word 'threshold' appears. The earlier form passed unchanged when the default was moved to 9999.00 — a silent change to the safe default is exactly what this case exists to catch.
